DLC2310:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Yesterday's enemy is today's friend... It sounds simple enough when you put it into words, but reality rarely works so easily.」

DLC2310:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Especially for sensitive young people, fighting alongside someone they once tried to kill must stir up some very complicated feelings...」

DLC2310:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I'm about to tell takes place after $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ disbanded in $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

DLC2310:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They had defeated $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, the mastermind of the $$多元戦争$$, and even stopped the $$エグゼクター$$. Their bonds were strong, but...」

DLC2310:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems some of them still hadn't quite gotten past that awkwardness.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:3.en: ~$$ネェル・アーガマ$$ - Captain's Quarters~

DLC2310:3:t_2:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...It's been a while, $$アスラン$$. I'm glad to see you're doing well.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:5.en:
$$アスラン$$
「I know you're busy, Captain $$ブライト$$. Thank you for making time to see me.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't worry about it. Supervising joint exercises between the $$新地球連邦軍$$, $$ザフト$$ and the $$オーブ$$ military is nothing compared to the demands of wartime.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All I have to do is accompany the crew on their familiarization exercises aboard this ship, the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:8.en:
$$アスラン$$
「This ship... She's the $$アーガマ$$'s successor, isn't she?」

DLC2310:3:t_2:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Though her design is rather specialized, so I doubt she'll become the standard for the $$新地球連邦軍$$.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You went out of your way to ask to see us. There's something you wanted to discuss, isn't there?」

DLC2310:3:t_2:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm sure there's no bad blood left between them, but you can still see the awkwardness.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:16.en:
$$アスラン$$
「I understand how they both feel and where they're coming from, so I want to do something to help...」

DLC2310:3:t_2:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You certainly take your worries to heart, $$アスラン$$.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:18.en:
$$アスラン$$
「I know I'm meddling, but...」

DLC2310:3:t_2:19.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Still, the fact that you can openly ask someone for help shows how much you've grown, too.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:20.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And when you do, we can hardly turn you down.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:21.en:
$$クワトロ$$
「Do you have any good ideas?」

DLC2310:3:t_2:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Nothing elaborate. I was thinking of using the exercises as a pretext to assign the three of them a mission.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:25.en:
$$クワトロ$$
「No... I don't believe it's something I should get involved in.」

DLC2310:3:t_2:27.en:
$$アスラン$$
「What is this mission...? And what do you mean, three of them...?」

DLC2310:3:t_2:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Someone to act as a buffer. He's been concerned about this, too.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:3.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「...Did something good happen, $$シン$$?」

DLC2310:3:t_3:5.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「You've been in a good mood ever since you got back.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:6.en:
$$シン$$
「O-of course I haven't! We just found out that some group called $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is on the move!」

DLC2310:3:t_3:8.en:
$$シン$$
「Anyway, $$ルナ$$... Want to get dinner together tonight?」

DLC2310:3:t_3:9.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Are you asking me on a date to keep me quiet?」

DLC2310:3:t_3:11.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's all go out for Japanese food.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:13.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Things with $$シン$$... You're all right now, aren't you?」

DLC2310:3:t_3:16.en:
$$キラ$$
「You can't do that, $$アスラン$$. You have to actually say these things.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:18.en:
$$キラ$$
「Trying to help the other person understand you is just as important as trying to understand them.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:19.en:
$$アスラン$$
「All right, $$キラ$$. I'll remember that.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:20.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Then let me come right out and ask. Tell me what happened with $$シン$$.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:21.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll tell you over dinner. Together with $$シン$$.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...$$シン$$ and $$キラ$$... One too stubborn, the other unable to express himself... It seems they needed to face each other head-on to get past that wall.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though I do sympathize with poor $$カミーユ$$ for getting dragged along.」

DLC2310:3:t_3:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perhaps if I opened my heart a little more, I could grow closer to all of you, too...」

DLC2310:3:t_3:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2310:4:t_000:0.en:
$$シン$$
「...Still, sending just the three of us on a reconnaissance mission... Captain $$ブライト$$ works us as hard as ever.」

DLC2310:4:t_000:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't complain, $$シン$$. The captain, Captain $$アムロ$$ and the others are busy with the joint exercises.」

DLC2310:4:t_000:2.en:
$$シン$$
「The whole $$エグゼクター$$ mess has settled down. We don't have to be in such a hurry...」

DLC2310:4:t_000:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But we don't know what lies ahead. There still seem to be people trying to stir up conflict between Earth and space.」

DLC2310:4:t_000:4.en:
$$シン$$
「We crushed $$ロゴス$$ and $$ブルーコスモス$$, so where do these people keep coming from...?」

DLC2310:4:t_000:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What do you think, $$キラ$$?」

DLC2310:4:t_000:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（This silence is painful... I wish $$ルナマリア$$ were here, or $$アスラン$$ could step in between them...）

DLC2310:4:t_000:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（I'm worried about their relationship, but I don't know what I could do to help...）

DLC2310:4:t_000:13.en:
$$シン$$
「...$$カミーユ$$... Is there something in this sector?」

DLC2310:4:t_000:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I haven't been told the details, either.」

DLC2310:4:t_000:15.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They said to report whatever I sensed, without any preconceptions, but...」

DLC2310:4:t_001:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（That sensation just now... Captain $$クワトロ$$...?）

DLC2310:4:t_002:1.en:
$$シン$$
「It's off the regular route. Maybe it's having some kind of trouble...」

DLC2310:4:t_002:2.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Seriously?! They're too far away to see clearly, but aren't those three mobile suits $$ガンダム$$s?!」

DLC2310:4:t_002:3.en:
$$ミコット$$
「This is no time for that, $$タクヤ$$! There's been something wrong with this shuttle for a while now!」

DLC2310:4:t_002:4.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「They said we strayed a little off course and we're just hurrying to make up for it.」

DLC2310:4:t_002:5.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You think so, too, right? Um... Ba...」

review.context: Athrun asks the senior officers to help Shinn and Kira move past their awkwardness; Kamille joins their reconnaissance mission and they meet a distressed civilian shuttle.
decisions: The post-mission dinner scene precedes the playable flashback; the target of Shinn's dinner invitation broadens from Luna to the group.
The anonymous third participant is Kamille, established by the subsequent mission scene.
